name: SEO Expert: Digital Darts
description: Get your Shopify store found on Google and in AI search. SEO Expert scans every product, collection, page and blog post, scores your store, and shows what to fix first. In Claude, ask for an SEO health summary, list the issues that matter most, and see which pages are missing meta titles, descriptions or image alt text. Then fix it in chat. Update meta tags, write alt text, and repair broken links with redirects. Changes apply to your store immediately and every write is recorded in the app's activity log. You can also review Google Search performance and backlinks, and queue a fresh store-wide audit. Built on 10 years of Shopify SEO. Requires the SEO Expert: Digital Darts app from the Shopify App Store.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SEO Expert: Digital Darts to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SEO Expert: Digital Darts to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://seo.digitaldarts.com.au/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SEO Expert: Digital Darts MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SEO Expert: Digital Darts provides these MCP tools: create_redirect, get_backlinks, get_page_seo, get_resource, get_search_performance, get_seo_summary, list_broken_links, list_resources, list_seo_issues, run_audit, update_image_alt, and update_meta_tags.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SEO Expert: Digital Darts?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SEO Expert: Digital Darts in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does SEO Expert: Digital Darts MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: SEO Expert: Digital Darts requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops SEO Expert: Digital Darts?

acceptedAnswer.text: SEO Expert: Digital Darts is developed by Digital Darts. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
